messages.text: The baseline differential suite is now fully green byte-for-byte, including Unicode tables and the division-by-zero status/error path. Before treating that as sufficient, I’m expanding the completion audit across the named scope—flags and newline behavior, nested JSON/CSV variants, table filters/transforms, stdin, and filesystem side effects—because a 23-case smoke manifest would otherwise be a weak proxy for the requested benchmark surface.

commands.commandLine: {"command":"$r=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); $cases=@('[1 2 3 4] | math avg','[1 5 2] | math median','[2 3 4] | math product','9 | math sqrt','-4 | math abs','3.6 | math round','\"AbCa\" | str downcase','\"hello world\" | str contains world','\"hello\" | str starts-with he','\"hello\" | str ends-with lo','\"abcdef\" | str substring 1..3','\"abc\" | str reverse','\"abcabc\" | str replace --all a X'); foreach($c in $cases){ Write-Output ('CASE '+$c); & $r -n --no-std-lib -c $c; Write-Output ('EXIT '+$LASTEXITCODE) }","workdir":"C:\\Users\\liuliu\\Documents\\tura-benchmark\\raw\\project-rebuild-source-port\\r-9a0a3715a0\\nushell\\tura-balanced-1\\workspace","timeout_ms":40000}
